description: Renovate keeps the sha256-pinned release downloads in the workflows current (gitleaks,
actionlint, osv-scanner, the Codacy coverage reporter), which Dependabot cannot see, and the
fuzz image's base (.clusterfuzzlite/Dockerfile, pinned as tag@sha256), whose new digest it
Everything else stays with Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml, which has no docker entry), so
the two never propose the same update.
Each pin is marked in its step's env with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=owner/repo`
line directly above the VERSION (the release tag) and SHA256 lines. The
github-release-attachments datasource finds the asset the current sha256 belongs to and
proposes the new tag together with that asset's new sha256. tests/unit/part19.py gates that
every pinned download is matched, and that the dockerfile manager reads that one file only.

customManagers.description: Workflow release downloads pinned by tag and sha256
